name: cost-ledger
description: Cost ledger across all chats: after every answer it records the chat cost (as /cost), tokens per model and model calls made by other mods. /ledger shows today, 7 and 30 days, total, history by model (days or weeks), projects and the most expensive chats. Observer only, no model calls.

language.title: Language / Sprache
language.description: Language of the mod's texts and of its model prompts. en: English, de: Deutsch.

keepDays.title: Retention (days)
keepDays.description: Chats that have not been recorded for this many days are deleted by cost-ledger at the next /ledger.

dayYellow.title: Daily amount yellow from ($)
dayYellow.description: From this daily amount (chat + mods), the amount in the daily history turns yellow.

dayRed.title: Daily amount red from ($)
dayRed.description: From this daily amount (chat + mods), the amount in the daily history turns red.
